announcements.t: Seshaasai Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 25, 2026, titled Seshaasai Technologies Secures Contract with Leading Public Sector Life Insurer for Centralized Printing and Fulfilment Services". |SUBJECT: Press Release
announcements.desc: The contract was awarded through a tendering process, in which Seshaasai emerged as one of the two successful bidders and secured a significant share of the customer’s business under the tender.
